title: Preventing Trap Seal Loss from Siphonage
description: A proper P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common issue occurs when a trap is unvented or incorrectly configured, creating a siphon effect that pulls the water seal out of the trap dip after a fixture drains. To prevent self-siphoning, ensure the trap arm extends horizontally to a properly located vent before dropping vertically. Maintaining this protective water seal is essential for occupant safety and code-compliant drain trap operation.
caption:
Preventing Trap Seal Loss from Siphonage

A proper P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common issue occurs when a trap is unvented or incorrectly configured, creating a siphon effect that pulls the water seal out of the trap dip after a fixture drains. To prevent self-siphoning, ensure the trap arm extends horizontally to a properly located vent before dropping vertically. Maintaining this protective water seal is essential for occupant safety and code-compliant drain trap operation.
